reason: The plugin is primarily a user-facing DeepSeek Harness sidebar enhancement that renders a game-style status HUD (HP/MP/TIME) and shows provider resource state and session/workspace timing, so it is best classified as a navigation panel UI plugin rather than a backend tool.

summaries.zh: dsh-hud 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，在侧边栏中显示游戏化 HP/MP/TIME 状态面板，展示会话上下文、Provider 资源与工作区累计耗时，并支持宽/窄 Rail 的显示模式。
summaries.en: dsh-hud is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows a game-style HUD in the sidebar for session context (HP), provider quota/balance (MP), and workspace elapsed time (TIME), with both normal and compact rail modes.

capabilities: Displays a sidebar HUD with HP/MP/TIME status for session context, provider resources, and workspace time
Retrieves provider quota/balance data via external provider endpoints for MP calculations
Tracks turn start/end intervals to accumulate workspace activity time

reasons.code: README states the plugin adds a game-style HP/MP/TIME HUD directly in DeepSeek Harness sidebar with wide and 56px rail presentations.
README documents MP data sources (`/user/balance` and `/zen/go/v1/usage`) for DeepSeek Official and OpenCode Go via provider-aware routing.
README states TIME is computed from `turn/start` to `turn/end` intervals with interval-union deduplication across sessions.
